title: Decorative Plants
description: Enhance your space by incorporating potted greenery, bringing an organic and stylish feel to your indoor & outdoor area.

detail.metaDescription: Style indoor and outdoor spaces with potted greenery — Balga Designs' Pot Styling Package ($2,000) brings an organic, healthy feel to any space.
detail.whatItIs: Styling your space with potted greenery to bring an organic, stylish feel to both indoor and outdoor areas.
detail.whenYouNeed: When you want greenery and warmth without a full garden build — perfect for balconies, courtyards, entrances, patios and interiors.
detail.whatsInvolved: Our Potted Greenery / Pot Styling Package is $2,000 and centres on selecting and arranging potted plants to suit your space and style.
detail.whyBalga: We choose plants that thrive in your conditions and pair them beautifully with your space, so the result looks considered and stays healthy.
